notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.403 makes Arduino and NI-DAQ connections independent. Arduino-only operation shows Arduino signals and allows device control after the existing firmware handshake. NI-DAQ-only operation supports Live View and recording while Arduino controls remain disabled and device commands are refused. Uncalibrated NI pressure channels show volts.

USB discovery now runs read-only in the background. Devices attached after startup appear without restarting the application; use Connect for Arduino. A newly detected NI-DAQ can join an existing live view. Disconnecting one source leaves the other view usable. Starting Live View resumes rendering if it had been paused, and a lost final source resets the view for a clean retry.

Validation: 55 focused checks and all seven standard GUI scripts passed; the final fixture correction and native receipt gates also passed 29 checks. The compiled installer self-check additionally verifies late-attachment discovery, NI-only viewing and a refused device command. Discovery preserves None when a previously selected Due disappears and another device appears. Firmware remains rev27v-followup-355; calibration, PID, protocol targets and actuator control are unchanged. Full revised SysID qualification remains open.
